title: Rain Man
description: A wheeler-dealer (Tom Cruise) meets his brother (Dustin Hoffman), an institutionalized autistic-savant, heir to $3 million.

title: RoboCop
description: Scientists use the mangled remains of a dead police officer to create the ultimate crime-fighter -- an indestructible cyborg.

title: Mad Max
description: In an Australia of the not-too-distant future, a police officer strikes back against motorized menaces to what is left of society after a nuclear holocaust.
